The decisive mistake was the Orchestrator's ledger update at step 9. The question explicitly includes Oko, Thief of Crowns (including Oko, Crown of Thorns) among the candidates, but the instruction to WebSurfer listed only "Once Upon a Time" and "Veil of Summer." Oko was left out of the price lookup, so the run could never identify the correct card. The later failures (no price data for Veil of Summer, and the forced "Once Upon a Time" answer at the time limit) followed from this omission.
